macros.name: rbresetbracketmax
macros.doc: Description: Resets the max coloring level to the package default.

macros.name: rbresetbrackets
macros.doc: Resets the bracket symbol(s). If used outside an rb environment it will reset the global bracket symbol(s) to the package default(s) (or the one(s) passed via the package arguments), if used within a rb environment it will reset them to the current environment default(s).

macros.name: rbresetrbracket
macros.doc: Resets the bracket symbol(s). If used outside an rb environment it will reset the global bracket symbol(s) to the package default(s) (or the one(s) passed via the package arguments), if used within a rb environment it will reset them to the current environment default(s).

macros.name: rbsetlbracket
macros.doc: Change the bracket symbol mid document.

macros.name: rbsetrbracket
macros.doc: Change the bracket symbol mid document.

macros.name: rbsetstyle
macros.doc: Changes the color scheme mid document to the specified style.

envs.name: rbb
envs.doc: Same as rb environment but all parentheses are in bold mode.
